entries.title: Hosea 13:1
segments: ¶When Ephraim spoke, trembling, He exalted [himself] in Israel; But when he offended through Baal [worship], he died.

entries.title: Hosea 13:2
segments: Now they sin more and more, And have made for themselves molded images, Idols of their silver, according to their skill; All of it [is] the work of craftsmen. They say of them, "Let the men who sacrifice kiss the calves!"

entries.title: Hosea 13:3
segments: Therefore they shall be like the morning cloud And like the early dew that passes away, Like chaff blown off from a threshing floor And like smoke from a chimney.

entries.title: Hosea 13:4
segments: "Yet I [am] the LORD your God Ever since the land of Egypt, And you shall know no God but Me; For [there is] no Savior besides Me.

entries.title: Hosea 13:5
segments: ¶I knew you in the wilderness, In the land of great drought.

entries.title: Hosea 13:6
segments: When they had pasture, they were filled; They were filled and their heart was exalted; Therefore they forgot Me.

entries.title: Hosea 13:7
segments: "So I will be to them like a lion; Like a leopard by the road I will lurk;

entries.title: Hosea 13:8
segments: I will meet them like a bear deprived [of her cubs]; I will tear open their rib cage, And there I will devour them like a lion. The wild beast shall tear them.

entries.title: Hosea 13:9
segments: ¶"O Israel, you are destroyed, But your help [is] from Me.

entries.title: Hosea 13:10
segments: I will be your King; Where [is any other], That he may save you in all your cities? And your judges to whom you said, 'Give me a king and princes'?

entries.title: Hosea 13:11
segments: I gave you a king in My anger, And took [him] away in My wrath.

entries.title: Hosea 13:12
segments: "The iniquity of Ephraim [is] bound up; His sin [is] stored up.

entries.title: Hosea 13:13
segments: The sorrows of a woman in childbirth shall come upon him. He [is] an unwise son, For he should not stay long where children are born.

entries.title: Hosea 13:14
segments: "I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death. O Death, I will be your plagues! O Grave, I will be your destruction! Pity is hidden from My eyes.

entries.title: Hosea 13:15
segments: Though he is fruitful among [his] brethren, An east wind shall come; The wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness. Then his spring shall become dry, And his fountain shall be dried up. He shall plunder the treasury of every desirable prize.

entries.title: Hosea 13:16
segments: Samaria is held guilty, For she has rebelled against her God. They shall fall by the sword, Their infants shall be dashed in pieces, And their women with child ripped open.
